title: AI-generated rendering of Incident 1: orange orb over a desert valley at dusk
description: Under the heading "Drawings or Sketches", the text says these "are AI-generated images of the three incidents based on prompts and descriptions I provided" and that the lights are "merely a rendering of relative size but are not to exact scale." The single image, labeled "Incident 1", shows a dark desert valley between mountain ridges with a red-orange glow on the horizon. A bright orange orb with a few small red lights near it hangs above the valley, and a faint footpath leads away in the foreground. Marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 5.
